{{Quote|N-Nomi. Where am I?''"<br />"''You're still aboard ''Reliance I'', in the infirmary.|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] and [[Nomi Sunrider]]|audio=UlicNomiRelianceI-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="TOTJ:TDLOTSa" />}}
The '''''Reliance I''''' was a [[Republic command ship]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] during the opening stages of the [[Krath Holy Crusade]].<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Reliance I'' was equipped with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and a specialized bridge atmospheric containment field.<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" /> The vessel was equipped with a shipboard infirmary, complete with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] tanks and medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TOTJ:TDLOTSa" />

==History==
Under the command of [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] [[Orley Vanicus]], she was damaged by an assault wave of [[CX-133 Chaos fighter|Chaos fighters]] at [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] during the [[Battle of Koros Major]], when swarms of the small attack [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[CX-133 Chaos fighter]] were used in kamikaze strikes against the Republic fleet and one such craft crashed into the ''Reliance I''{{'s}} bridge viewports.<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" />

Although the hole was quickly sealed off by an atmospheric force-field and the burning wreckage was cooled quickly, there were several casualties among the command crew. [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] himself was injured by flying shrapnel from the impact and spent some time with a fever in the ship's infirmary.<ref name="TOTJ:TDLOTSa" />
